Summary: The HotpotQA dataset has a total of 112,779 valid examples, with 7,405 examples in the validation set. The dataset includes a train-medium subset of 56,814 examples, which are correctly answered by models 60% of the time. The dataset also has a train-easy subset of 18,089 examples and a train-hard subset of 15,661 examples. The overall dataset was collected on Amazon Mechanical Turk using the ParlAI interface.
